name: Jessica S. Allen
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed February 17, 2021 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 4.

biography.text: Allen earned a B.A. from Rutgers University (1992) and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1996). She clerked for Magistrate Judge Madeline Cox Arleo and former Magistrate Judge Ronald J. Hedges, served as a New Jersey Assistant Attorney General and an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey, and became a partner at the Killian Firm, where she handled employment, consumer-fraud, and insurance matters.
